title: Phase 5 immutable result and cold replay
objective: Implement a versioned immutable internal PARI class-group result envelope with atomic idempotent publication and independent fail-closed cold replay over prepared candidates plus optional transform, unit, and generator evidence

oracles: Independent canonical decode plus exact integer matrix and transcript replay

handoff.summary: Added the versioned sagejs.pari-class-group/internal-result-v1 boundary. Prepared native owners are detached by explicit logical lengths with column-major matrices normalized to row-major schema data. Cold replay proves two-way relation-lattice/HNF inclusion, exact Smith transformations and inverses, decreasing PARI invariant factors, canonical generator coverage and orders, linked factored-unit norms, and a candidate-selected scaled-log determinant. Publication validates before a locked one-time assignment, is idempotent by canonical bytes, rejects conflicting terminal results, and enforces optional pinned publication authority. The status is deliberately published-partial-v1: schema_components_present is only presence, while phase5_complete and public_complete remain false with five explicit unverified requirements. The focused check covers 55 authenticated mutations, 13 rehashed semantic mutations, one pinned retained-evidence mutation, invalid-before-publication behavior, concurrent idempotence, the independent review's coordinated unrelated-evidence counterexample, and the authentic 303-relation rectangular corridor. Independent re-review found no remaining high-severity issue. Final strict Python and the full 21-minute native correctness/performance gate pass after a clean build.
risks: Ideal HNFs, principal-generator coordinates, torsion coordinates, and factored unit elements are authenticated retained data, not yet independently replayed through number-field ideal/unit arithmetic; the terminal record therefore cannot claim Phase-5 completeness.

After the clean build, the architecture audit passes FFI, package, numerical, native, Wasm, resource, and CoWasm checks, then stops because the base integration commit's optimizer-opportunity manifest predates its compiler changes. This lane changes only new bench Python/CJS/Markdown files; the integration owner is already regenerating that shared manifest.
The initial strict run caught and led to correction of doubled-backtick docstring syntax. Final strict Python and the complete native correctness/performance gate pass.
next_steps: Wire authentic Phase-3 transformation evidence into the two lattice-inclusion witnesses and Smith fields.

Extend independent replay with exact ideal multiplication/principality, exact unit/torsion arithmetic, rigorous regulator acceptance, factor-base authentication, and the complete buchall_end state before changing phase5_complete.
Regenerate the shared optimizer-opportunity manifest on the merged integration checkpoint, then rerun the complete architecture audit.
